title: An older completed run can hide the latest failed re-review
problem: The query excludes failed runs before it orders by recency. An older completed run at the same head can then hide a newer failed re-review. This happens after same-head reviews, including a base retarget. The older approval may already be dismissed. A later receiver retry treats the old verdict as current and does not replace the failed review.
suggestion: Load the latest run at the head without excluding statuses. Restart it when it is queued. Create a replacement when its latest status is failed or superseded. Only return early when the latest run is live or delivered.
